explanation:
The central tree reduces the seed from 106 to 69 lines (34.9%) and from 8,407 to 5,104 characters excluding the seed's trailing newline (39.3%). It organizes the runtime around boundaries, ownership, transitions and handoffs. Five peripherals provide mechanisms and exceptions. Session lifecycle and dirty-state formulas now have one primary explanatory location. Data dependency remains a cross-cutting computation view rather than another organizational hierarchy.

Source-grounded corrections: MappingEditorRuntime.ts:144-147 deletes the entire detected clone batch when any clone is unsupported, rather than removing only unsupported clones. MappingPage.tsx:468-470 registers all non-hidden drafts, including inactive ones. Explicit save captures state, calls sync([id]), flushes, checks the captured version, then publishes; sync is not passed the captured document (912-927). Generic apply has no explicit flush in its branch, unlike create-diagrams and canvas-generation (316-330, 434-458). Projection-copy navigation replaces only the child session and preserves the source archive (788-808), qualifying the seed's general transfer description.

Details absent from the seed include copy isolation and selective store publication (canvasWorkspace.ts:42-90; canvasSession.ts:69-84), fixed sizing after native resize (MappingEditorRuntime.ts:175-192), projection exclusions and focus invalidation (shapeProjection.ts:26-43; CanvasRuntimeContext.tsx:123-179), and deferred worker-failure publication (NativeRoutingStore.ts:86-115).

The critique's repetition, attachment-scope and placement recommendations are applied. Related-point labels use only relationships supplied in context.json. Cross-point reconciliation is not adopted where it would require unprovided evidence; other points are not recreated. Controller, persistence adapter, bridge, receiver and worker implementations remain outside the pinned sources, so visible calls do not establish their internal guarantees. Previous output and critique were used as review material, not code evidence.

All trees contain printable ASCII and LF newlines. Validated 1-based concept endpoints, connectivity, character limits and nonoverlapping text rectangles. Peripherals sit near their attachment rows with clear column gaps. Rendered connector routing and interaction behavior remain unverified.
